purpose: Repair research input-delivery isolation, not semantic grounding rules.

trust_boundary.host_evidence: A separately implemented and frozen adapter must capture host-controlled input assembly and delivery, not merely repeat the coordinator's intended allowlist.
trust_boundary.author_disclosure: Supplemental negative evidence only: known excluded exposure stops, unknown blocks, a clean self-report cannot establish host completeness.
trust_boundary.opaque_platform: Do not request hidden instructions, hidden reasoning, secrets, or privileged prompt text. Record opaque policy/runtime components by available identity and an independently reviewable no-project-retrieval boundary. If project/history injection cannot be excluded at that boundary, BLOCK.
trust_boundary.claim_limit: Byte hashes authenticate saved identity, not truthful completeness, cognitive independence, model pretraining non-exposure or absence of latent inference.
trust_boundary.current_channel: The v0.1 non-forked repository-author channel is unqualified; six known-exposed reports cannot be cleared by a new thread, changed cwd, AGENTS override or self-attestation.

inventory_contract.unknown_rule: Missing category, unsupported suppression setting, missing audit evidence or uncertain project-content boundary blocks; do not replace unknown with empty.
inventory_contract.included_rule: Every included host-controlled payload requires a byte hash, role, sequence, source class, and precommitted allowlist match. Content must contain no study results, question text, graph, binding, answer or historical label in this diagnostic.
inventory_contract.privacy_rule: Keep secrets and machine-local paths out of portable receipts; use logical resource identities. Do not publish privileged platform text.

receipt_contract.binding_rule: Host capture and author disclosure must bind the same unique context/nonce, exact configuration, ordered delivered bytes and frozen plan. Host evidence must have a verifiable origin outside the author's response; a hand-filled coordinator attestation is not sufficient.
receipt_contract.replay_rule: Never reuse a clearance across contexts, resumed threads, config/tool changes or added inputs. Every future research context requires its own pre-packet gate and post-delivery audit.
receipt_contract.provenance_rule: Record actual transport/model identifiers; exact revision, seed and backend raw-stream capture must explicitly say unavailable when not exposed. Self-report is not backend authentication.

cases.description: Only frozen neutral diagnostic inputs; qualification additionally requires complete independently evidenced host boundary, never just canary absence.
Deliberately inject an approved synthetic exclusion marker through a project-instruction-like source; never use real AGENTS or study facts.
Withhold a controlled inventory component; the verifier must refuse clearance even if the author claims clean.

probe_contract.retry_policy: Preserve failed or incomplete first captures; no outcome-conditioned replacement. Changing adapter or protocol requires a new version and output-absent freeze.
probe_contract.positive_control_limit: Detection of a known marker tests one path only; non-detection of an unknown marker cannot prove total isolation.
probe_contract.future_probe_gate: If no available authorized transport can supply sufficient host evidence, record BLOCKED_UNVERIFIABLE_CONTEXT before model dispatch and request the missing transport/authority; never fabricate a receipt.

branch_order.when: in this context: known excluded content, premature research delivery, contradictory or tampered evidence, replay, or forbidden retrieval
no known failure but any inventory boundary, source evidence, provenance binding or author exposure status is unknown/unverifiable
no known failure/unknown boundary, but any planned capture or control result is missing
this context has complete bound evidence and no preceding stop/block/incomplete condition; this is transport-scoped diagnostic qualification, never research authorization

aggregate_probe_rule: Apply branch_order per context. The known-injection and opaque controls must STOP and BLOCK respectively; those expected outcomes are not failures of the suite. Any unexpected control outcome stops the suite; missing captures make it incomplete; an unverifiable closed-context case blocks it. Only all three expected outcomes plus independently verified host evidence qualify the adapter for consideration of a separate plan. Expected control results never qualify the contaminated or opaque contexts themselves.

identity_migration.old_packet_protocol_sha256: Preserved v0.1 field hashes the author guide; protocol itself remains transitively bound. This is a naming defect, not byte corruption.
identity_migration.hash_rule: Each field hashes the exact bytes of its explicitly named component. Define payload canonicalization separately before implementation; do not alias protocol and guide identities.
